paite: Huan David in Israel heutu tengteng nam makaipente, kumpipa nasem a kikheng zelzel pawl heutute, sepaih sangkhat heutute, zakhat heutute, kumpipa leh atapate sum leh thil neih tengteng tung a heutute, milian mihat, mihat hangsan tengtengte toh Jerusalem ah asamkhawm hi.
heading: Tempul A Dia David Thilgelte

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David adingh a, "Ka unaute leh ka mite aw, ka thu na ngaikhia dih ua, ke'n TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna leh i Pathian khe ngakna ding inn lam lungsim in ka nei gige a; alamna ding leng ka ngah khin sipsip hi.
Himahleh, Pathian in ka kiang ah, 'Nang zaw kidoumi sisan suahmi na hih ziak in ka min a ding in inn na lam kei ding,' achi hi.

Himahleh TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, ka pa inkote tengteng lak a kipan Israelte kumpipa dia tangtawn a om ding in ahon na telta a; Judah makai pipen ding in ana telta a; Judah namte lak ah ka pa inkote; ka pa tapate lak a kipan Israel tengteng kumpipa ding in ahon na telkhe tuamta hi.
TOUPA'N tapa tampi ahon pia a, ka tapa tengteng lak ah, Israelte kumpipa ding in TOUPA gam laltutphah a tu ding in ka tapa Solomon ana telta hi.
"Huchi in ka kiang ah, 'Na tapa Solomon in ka inn leh ka intualte adingsak ding; ka tapa ding in ka telta a, huchi in apa ka hi ding.
Ka thupiakte leh ka vaihawmte apom gigeleh tua na hih gige bang un agam tangtawn a ding in ka kipsak ding hi.'

Huchi in TOUPA mipi, Israelte tengteng mitmuh in leh i Pathian zak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak tengteng pom ding leh limsak ding in ka hon hanthawn ahi; huchi in hiai gam hoih mahmah na luah ding ua, na nung uah na suante uh tangtawn a ding in na luahtou sawnsak zel ding uhi.

"Huan nang, ka tapa Solomon, na pa Pathian thei inla, lungtang hoih bukim leh lungsim kilawptak in anasep sem in; TOUPA'N lah lungtang a-en sek a, lungsim a lunggel tengteng athei vek hi; amah na zonleh na mu ding a, na lehngatsanleh bel tangtawn in ahon khahkhe ding hi.
Pilvang in; mun siangthou a dia inn lam ding in TOUPA'N nang ahon septa; hattak in om inla, pang in," achi hi.
Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah atempul intual, asum koihkhawmna, adantan tungnung, asung dantan, azahngaihna tutphah,
Alungsim a alunggel bang tengteng, TOUPA' inn um sung intual, akim dantan tengteng, Pathian in asum koihkhawmna inn, thil tan koihkhawmna inn lamdan ding guhgel apia hi.
Siampute leh Levite apawlpawl a a-omna ding uh lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna lam ding tengteng lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding tui-um belsuan tengteng lim leng.
Nasepna lam a dia tui-um belsuan chi chih, dangka-eng tui-um belsuan ding, dangka-eng zat zel zah ding,

Dangka-eng khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak ding dangka-eng zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak tui ding a zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna a mun kiphamoh chiat bang zel a dangkasik khawnvak koihna ding a dia zat zel zah ding toh;
tanghou at koihna ding dangka-eng dohkan leh dangkasik dohkan bawlna ding a, dangka-eng zat zah ding leh dangkasik zat zel zah ding atehna in apia hi.
Maiphiatna kuang, noute toh; dangka-eng belhbu ding, belhbu khat zel a dia zat zel zah ding.
Cherubte akha uh zak a; TOUPA thukhun bawm tuam tuanna lim bang bawlna ding dangka-engte toh.
David in, "Hiaite tengteng TOUPA'N amah mah khut a hon gelh, hiai a lim tengteng hon theisak hi in ka thei," achi hi.

Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om inla, pang in; lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n; TOUPA Pathian, ka Pathian na kiang ah a-om hi; TOUPA' inn lam nasep tengteng zoh ahih vek mateng hon paisan in, ahon limsak lou kei ding hi.

Huan ngai dih, Pathian in na chih teng semmi pawl siampute leh Levite a-om ua, bang nna peuh a, bang lam peuh a nasep siam, hattak chiat a nang hon panpih ding na kiang ah a-om zel ding uhi; heutute leh mipi teng in leng na thupiak peuhmah azui ding uhi," achi hi.
